source.license: Project art; inherits exact source terms in ASSET_LICENSES.md
source.acceptance_scope: Identity still only. Garden separated art remains review-only. No prior animation frames reused.

fixed: Camera/background, plant root bands, seesaw pedestal, gate masonry, swing frame
entry_exit: Exact normalized source at t=0 and t=4 seconds
method: Local keyed 2D deformation/layer articulation; premultiplied RGBA sampling; Aseprite master
geometry: 256 padded canvas; plant root y>=228; seesaw axle (128,193); gate hinges x104/x151
tolerances: Plant crown 32-56px peak-to-peak, fixed support, no edge clipping, periodic endpoint exact
stop_fallback: Stop on drift/contact failure; no rejected-frame reuse. Swing remains missing-view gap.
seam_tolerance: Rest-adjacent frame39/0/1 maximum RGBA step <=2 color codes; fades to unlit source through cyclic sin(t/2)^2 envelope.
hold_purpose: Quantized unlit rest around the loop boundary, approximately300ms; glint fades in/out rather than resetting abruptly.
local_refinement: Correct hard rest reset; no generated calls or new identity art.
